newsitem.title: USA: Hickory Tech gets nod to buy 11 exchanges.
newsitem.headline: Hickory Tech gets nod to buy 11 exchanges.

text.p: Hickory Tech Corp said Monday it received approval from the Federal Communications Commission to buy 11 telephone exchanges in Iowa.

In 1994, U S West Communications Group agreed to sell the exchanges of Lakota, Bancroft, Sibley, Rock Rapids, Doon, Hull, Boyden, Rock Valley, Hawarden, Ireton and Akron to Hickory Tech. The transfer of ownership will be completed on April 10.
To fund the purchase, Hickory Tech issued a $40 million privately placed debt offering to institutional investors.
Hickory Tech of Mankato, Minn. will operate the exchanges under the name of Heartland Telecommunications Co of Iowa.
Hickory Tech is a communications holding company.
